messages:
Alice W: Hey team — trying out the new nextkit eval-stub from the bootcamp pack and hitting a weird auth/retry loop when the sample calls Redwood JS SDK. It retries forever and never returns an error, so the page hangs. Anyone seen this?
Ben R: repro steps? node version / yarn / env?
Alice W: Steps: clone repo, npm i, dev container, set REDWOOD_API_KEY to ephemeral key from console, run `npm run dev` then open /eval-stub. On first prompt it sends request but console shows repeated 401 then repeated 502s, browser shows spinning loader.
Cara P: can you paste the server logs? also which SDK version are you on? the bootcamp uses the latest @redwoodjs/sdk-beta tag.
Alice W: SDK version: 0.9.3-beta. Logs: ```[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] ERROR request failed: 401 Unauthorized - token expired
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] INFO retrying request (attempt 2)
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] ERROR request failed: 502 Bad Gateway
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] INFO retrying request (attempt 3)
...```
Sam K: hmm visible pattern: ephemeral token refresh path returns 200 but SDK treats some refresh responses as transient and keeps retrying. Might be missing a `shouldRetry` check on 401 when refresh happened.
Ben R: also saw a parity gap between python and ts clients — python auto-refreshes ephemeral keys + short-circuits retry, TS currently only retries raw on 5xx/429. That would explain the loop if the refresh side-effect isn't observed.
Cara P: I repro locally. Quick patch: in ts client add check after refresh to reset retry count and treat 401 post-refresh as terminal. I prototyped a fix in a branch.
Sam K: I opened PR #1523 with unit tests and a changelog entry — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1523 if you want to follow.
DevEx Bot: CI for PR #1523 — build passed (linux, macos, windows), tests 342/342 ✅
Ben R: thanks Sam. Two related DX notes: 1) eval-stub bootcamp README should include explicit instructions about ephemeral token TTLs and devcontainer copy-paste for REDWOOD_API_KEY, 2) add a one-liner workaround: `export REDWOOD_ALLOW_SHORT_RETRY_FIX=1` (temp env) until patch lands.
Alice W: I can update the bootcamp README after the PR merges — also noticed the sample's streaming example doesn't cancel the fetch on unmount which leaks sockets. That's a separate parity issue vs python sample-based streaming.
Cara P: added a follow-up issue for streaming cancel and telemetry noise: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/876 — includes a minimal repro and a suggested fix using AbortController.
Sam K: pinging @Docs team for a quickhand update — we should also add a small section in the onboarding checklist: "Run eval-stub locally" + expected logs.
Alice W: Great. Will retest once PR merges. Triage: blocker for the bootcamp release but we can ship the rest of content with a note pointing to PR #1523 as a patch.
Ben R: sounds good. If anyone wants to pair on the README edits I can review today. :thumbsup:
Alice W: Thanks everyone, will follow up here when verified.
